title: T-Shirt Included with this box
text:
Overall, it's awesome! Delightful. Difficult to go wrong with Chewbacca headlining. BTW all of these descriptions have pics for them except the Mystery Mini. POP! STAR WARS SMUGGLERS BOUNTY #300 is, Chewy! Or as it is displayed on the box, CHEWBACCA!
Many, I noticed, have been waiting for a T. This box has a very chill T-Shirt! Chewbacca hosting a snack at a table, possibly at the cantina :)
The Chewbacca Pint Glass is very cool for a chilled beverage. I made a mistake with Mystery Mini Yoda & opened the mini thinking, it may be something else. So, collectors take note! If you want Mystery Mini's as a collector item DO NOT OPEN! The displayed name is the item inside :)
The Mystery Mini in this box is Merumeru
(Everything in the box is individually displayed in the pics above EXCEPT for this item)
label: positive
